item.title: Wilkes-Barre pauses discussion of land sale, will be back on the agenda for a future meeting
item.description: WILKES-BARRE — Wilkes-Barre City Council will have a relatively empty agenda at Thursday’s regular meeting, as its sole item was removed before Tuesday’s work session, but will be added back on for discussion at a future meeting.

item.title: Luzerne County receives grant for open space and recreation plan
item.description: Luzerne County has received a $70,000 state grant to update the county’s Open Space, Greenways and Outdoor Recreation Master Plan, the county announced Wednesday.

item.title: Penguins return to ice without Crosby following injury at Olympics
item.description: PITTSBURGH — The Pittsburgh Penguins will have to start their playoff push without Sidney Crosby.

item.title: Bipartisan advocacy group obtains Luzerne County input on election-related concerns
item.description: A bipartisan advocacy group met with Luzerne County Election Director Emily Cook and County Manager Romilda Crocamo on Wednesday to hear election-related concerns that will be pitched to state legislators for suggested change.

item.title: Preparing for success: King’s College hosts mass casualty incident training
item.description: A mass casualty incident (MCI) training session was held Wednesday at King’s College.

item.title: Veteran Broadway dancer Sondra Lee dies at 97
item.description: NEW YORK — Sondra Lee, a dancer and actor discovered by the legendary choreographer-director Jerome Robbins and originated the role of Tiger Lily on Broadway in “Peter Pan” and played Minnie Fay in the original production of “Hello, Dolly!,” has died. She was 97.

item.title: New Penn State quarterback Rocco Becht working his way back from injuries
